facts.fact: Kelville 明知自己不受这家人欢迎却毫不在乎，照旧住了下来
facts.anchor: He knew he was persona non grata but didn’t seem to care

facts.fact: 到家的第二天，Kelville 就送了 Tamsin 一本花体签名的 Weyland's Burning Path
facts.anchor: On his second day, he gave her a copy of Weyland’s Burning Path, signed in his looping penmanship

facts.fact: Simon 警告 Livvie：Kelville 对 Tamsin 只图一样东西，而她像被眼镜蛇催眠的鸟
facts.anchor: He wants only one thing from her, and she’s like a bird hypnotized by a cobra with him

facts.fact: Simon 警告：Kelville 离开后会去下一家散布流言，让所有人往最坏处想
facts.anchor: he’ll slouch off to the house of whichever poor bastard is next on his list, where he’ll gossip and everyone will think the worst

facts.fact: Simon 透露自己的父亲想把他关在 Howth 的宅子里
facts.anchor: My father would like to keep me locked up at the house in Howth

facts.fact: Simon 劝 Livvie 当心 Tamsin：她像被踢过的狗，对人人讨好谄媚，被逼到角落就会攻击
facts.anchor: She’s like a dog that’s been kicked—it slinks around and cowers and tries to ingratiate itself with everyone, but when it’s cornered, it attacks

facts.fact: Tippy 来信说 Tansy 的宠物豹猫咬了 Bobby Glover，他被救护车送进 Guy's Hospital
facts.anchor: Tansy’s pet ocelot bit Bobby Glover on the derrière; they sent him off by ambulance to Guy’s Hospital

facts.fact: 白天的分开让 Livvie 和 Tamsin 的夜里更炽烈，两人如今总是同床
facts.anchor: the daylight hours Tamsin and I spent apart that week made our nights even more intense. By now, we always slept in the same bed
